text: Feed panel: the 'sent every 0.9 s' label in the frame-gap chart is drawn on top of the bars once they grow tall, hard to read (tick ~4806)

Feed: at 1.211 rs the panel says 'This is the last frame that will ever arrive. Everything Orpheus sent later is still climbing, and never gets out.' Frames sent between 1.21 and 1 rs (outside the horizon) should still escape, just very late; the wording implies light from outside the horizon is trapped. Tick 6276

After the feed objective completed (tick 6618), Ines asks 'Did it fall in, or is it stuck there?' but the choice only appeared once I pressed Esc to leave the feed console (tick ~6990). For ~370 ticks I sat at the console with no objective and no hint. Also the 'E Watch the probe camera' use-prompt is faintly visible through/behind the choice box.

The game went to PAUSE on its own at tick 7002, ~11 s after the 'What do you tell Ines?' choice appeared, with no key pressed by me (events: CHOICE 6984 -> PAUSE 7002). Pressing 1 while the pause menu was open still picked the answer (Ines's reply subtitle appeared) while the game stayed paused. Expected: no auto-pause during a choice, or keys 1/2 ignored while paused.

Epilogue: the expedition logbook opened on top of the PAUSE menu: both panels drawn at once and overlapping (pause menu's 'Frozen Star' title and buttons poke out from behind the logbook on the right). state screen=PAUSE. I had pressed nothing since tick ~7016. Background is the feed console's static, close up. Expected the logbook alone, cleanly.

Postscript: objective says 'Listen to WREN, then log a prediction' but there is no prediction UI at the helm; it only appeared (as a timed CHOICE) after I pressed Esc to leave the console, ~1100 ticks after the objective started (9534 -> 10826). Same pattern as the Orpheus 'What do you tell Ines?' choice. Nothing tells you to step back.

Photo mode: the 'Saved frozen-star-...png to your Downloads folder.' line appears a second or two after clicking Save picture and pushes the whole photo panel up ~23 px, so my click on Done (aimed where it had been, 913,677) missed and photo mode stayed open. After clicking Done at its new spot the ship came back and stayed visible (good).
